business_problem: replicate the company’s critical operational database into Snowflake fast enough to support trusted analytics, product decisions, and risk use cases without overloading production systems.
solution_summary: Mercury uses Snowflake and Snowflake Openflow on Snowflake to replicate the company’s critical operational database into snowflake fast enough to support trusted analytics, product decisions, and risk use cases without overloading production systems. Mercury’s full operational database, the same system that runs its app, is continuously replicated into Snowflake rather than copied in slower batch windows. Snowflake Openflow handles the ongoing replication and snapshot sync process, and Mercury supplements it with internal observability so engineers can inspect pipelines and resolve issues without vendor hand-holding. Analysts, data scientists, and product teams consume the fresh data for fraud detection, product launch reporting, near-real-time ML inference, and new customer-facing features. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, improves concurrency, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across teams and applications....

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Snowflake Openflow
solution_components.role: Continuously replicates operational data into Snowflake using managed data flows.

data_flow: the operational application database and replica snapshots flow into Snowflake and Snowflake Openflow; curated data and model outputs are then served to analysts, data scientists, product teams, and risk workflows.
business_outcome: Mercury reduced data latency to one to three minutes, eliminated replication incidents after migration, cut full resync time from more than a week to about two days, and removed about 20 hours of monthly data-engineering firefighting.
metrics: 1-3 Minutes of data latency to Snowflake, down from 30-60+ minutes
~2 Days to resync database, down from a week previously
~20 Hours per month of data engineering maintenance and firefighting removed
architecture_clues: Openflow is Snowflake’s managed integration service built on Apache NiFi.
Uses a read replica for snapshot syncs to avoid extra production load.
Team built an internal agent to monitor syncs directly through Openflow.
